shared_elements: low relief carving on a vertical stone surface
small figure-like forms in low relief near the base
faint horizontal banding/striation across the surface
justification: A presents a dense, legible programme of relief imagery \u2014 a row of animal heads at the top, a banded register, quadrupeds and birds in profile, and a large bird-headed creature at the base \u2014 whereas B shows an essentially blank vertical face whose only possible imagery is a few indistinct upright figure-like protrusions along the bottom and a faint mark high on the wall. The only correspondence is the generic idea of shallow figures placed low on a tall stone face; nothing in B repeats A's specific motifs, their stacking into registers, or its schematic profile-animal conventions.
